boundary_reasoning_to_test_not_a_patch.physical_condition: Before the scheduled drainage opening, the loaded face is hydraulically closed: q_n=-k/gamma*(gp+rho_w*Ace) dot n=0. Ace is the stored non-gravity acceleration: actual acceleration=Ace+Gravity and body acceleration=Gravity, so no additional gravity term is added to this flux.
boundary_reasoning_to_test_not_a_patch.local_target: For a valid unit normal n, R=(gp+rho_w*Ace) dot n and g_target=gp-n*R. Substituting this target in the Taylor-defect correction gives Lstar+R*(n dot lx), while retaining the existing acceleration-divergence term.
boundary_reasoning_to_test_not_a_patch.one_dimensional_frozen_form: Only the masked top row changes: Lstar to Lp and Da to Da+diag(mask*lx_z). Both the pressure-rate sigma block and pressure block must change. This is not merely globally disabling compensation, dropping dynamics or changing symC.
boundary_reasoning_to_test_not_a_patch.offline_counterfactual_only: A read-only hybrid of the measured initial A and independently reconstructed nominal top-row coefficients removed the positive real mode for either pressure-only Eq72-inspired replacement or the full-q target. This mixed model is NOT a measured modified C++ operator or an accepted solver, and near-zero negative eigenvalues are not a stability margin.
boundary_reasoning_to_test_not_a_patch.limits: A constructed target gradient satisfies a local algebraic condition, not necessarily the recomputed discrete pressure gradient or an integrated face flux. No global mass conservation, energy estimate, moving-surface consistency, variable-k compatibility or event switching is established. Zero/invalid normals must not silently pass.
